_about: BRAND WEIGHTS in Find Your Mat-ch suggestions (Tiffany Nov 11 4:59pm). On top of the general no-flooding rules (per-brand cap, never back to back), some brands get LESS room: weight 0.5 = half the slots every other brand gets, and a stricter match bar (their item must REALLY match: a high colour score, not a near miss). Their products are still in the app and always findable by name or brand search; weight only affects what we suggest. 1.0 = normal. Change only on Tiffany's word; revisit with FYM usage data.

Splash of Color.why: one of her least favorite brands; very AI-looking; largest catalog

Mahjong Studios.why: one of her least favorite brands (mats already excluded entirely)

Yellow Mountain Imports.why: one of her least favorite brands

Mah Jongg Maven.why: unexciting tile faces, but decently popular, good price point, colourful tiles: normal weight until we see how it does (big-catalog caps still apply)

Mahjong by SI.why: she thinks it's a better brand than Splash (nicer site, some decent mats, every mat in 4 formats); she's going to look; normal weight for now
